scientific_integrity: Exact finite signed character calculation with complete reproducible source; the published nonequivariant homology is a stated prerequisite. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The rational representation is determined for the full three-simplex only; no representation for arbitrary higher-dimensional simplices is asserted.
The computation does not assert an integral decomposition into Specht lattices, an equivariant wedge decomposition, or a corresponding result for the boundary or pure matching complexes.
The finite full enumeration is exact for the specified 28-vertex matching complex, but supplies no proof of a general large-simplex pattern.
Unindexed equivalent equivariant calculations cannot be ruled out by database and literature searches.
title: The complete \(S_4\)-character on tetrahedral discrete Morse matching homology
